utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are you still able to help with the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still looking for a few helpers, so if you can make it, I’d really appreciate it. We’re meeting this Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch. I can help out if you still need someone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren, that would be a big help. The drive has moved to Sunday at the community center now, so I’ll send you the updated time and setup details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can help out this Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. That helps a lot for Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, that should keep things moving. I’ll put you down for an hour or two on Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Pia. I’m still looking for a few more helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Vik, quick update: the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center. If you can still help, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Rosa. Yes, I can still help on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren. If you can, I could use someone to greet people and keep an eye on the tools this Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, sure, I can do that this Saturday on the front porch.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
